Publication.Title: JCX-1-25
Publication.Description:
List Of Expiring Federal Tax Provisions 2024-2034

The staff of the Joint Committee on Taxation has prepared a document listing Federal tax provisions that expired in 2024 or are scheduled to expire in the future. Years in which there are no expiring provisions are not included.

Publication.Title: JCX-2-25
Publication.Description:
Description Of H.R. 997, The “National Taxpayer Advocate Enhancement Act Of 2025”

On February 12, 2025, the House Committee on Ways and Means will hold a legislative markup of H.R. 997, the “National Taxpayer Advocate Enhancement Act of 2025,” H.R. 998, the “Internal Revenue Service Math and Taxpayer Help Act,” H.R. 1152, the “Electronic Filing and Payment Fairness Act,” and H.R. 1155, the “Recovery of Stolen Checks Act.”  The staff of the Joint Committee on Taxation provides descriptions of this legislation.

Publication.Title: JCX-26-25
Publication.Description:
Estimated Revenue Effects Of Tax Provisions To Provide For Reconciliation Of The Fiscal Year 2025 Budget As Passed By The House Of Representatives On May 22, 2025

The staff of the Joint Committee on Taxation provides estimates of the revenue effects of tax provisions to provide for reconciliation of the fiscal year 2025 budget as passed by the House of Representatives on May 22, 2025.
